responsibility: This file provides GCC’s GIMPLE-to-RTL expansion support for conditional-compare (CCMP) instruction sequences. It recognizes boolean SSA expressions built from comparisons combined with BIT_AND_EXPR or BIT_IOR_EXPR, recursively decomposes them into compare parts, asks target hooks gen_ccmp_first and gen_ccmp_next to build the target-specific CC/CCMP RTL sequences, estimates alternative expansion orders by sequence cost, and finally emits a cstore to materialize the boolean result. Its responsibility is specifically to lower eligible chained comparisons into target conditional-compare instructions during expansion, not to perform generic if-conversion or CFG optimization.
same_name_distinction: Implements the CCMP machinery declared in gcc/ccmp.h: it decides whether a GIMPLE boolean expression is a valid conditional-compare candidate, recursively orders and expands the comparison chain with target gen_ccmp_first/gen_ccmp_next hooks, and emits the final cstore. The header only exposes the expand_ccmp_expr entry point.
